why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Randy Arozarena is slot #2 (4.659 expected team runs/game).
Slots #2, #1, #3, #5, #6, #4, #7, #8, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #5 ranks 4 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.003 R/G.
Slot #2 yields 4.60 expected PA/game vs 4.27 at primary slot #5. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
